---
title: "Resources"
order: 9
---

External links for this lesson. All checked to load from a plain request as of the date this
page was written. (Note: eCFR's own site — ecfr.gov — blocks automated/proxied traffic with a
bot check in this repo's build environment, even though a human browser reaches it fine; the
regulation text quoted in this lesson comes from eCFR's public Versioner API instead, and the
links below use verified-loading mirrors of the same official text.)

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 606.165, current text](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.165)**
  — the distribution and receipt record requirements this lesson quotes to mark the exact point
  a unit crosses from Lakeshore's system of record into a hospital's.

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 606.170, current text](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.170)**
  — the adverse reaction file and fatality reporting requirements this lesson builds its
  transfusion-reaction section around, including the forwarding obligation that keeps Lakeshore
  in the loop after a reaction is traced to the product.

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 600.15, current text](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/600.15)**
  — the full shipping-temperature table this lesson excerpts, including the row for Red Blood
  Cells and every other blood product on the list; also shows the vaccine products this lesson
  didn't quote, since the section covers all of Part 600's biologics, not just blood.

- **[GovInfo: Code of Federal Regulations](https://www.govinfo.gov/app/collection/cfr)** — the
  U.S. Government Publishing Office's official, legally authoritative annual CFR archive. Use
  this for the official, dated, legally citable version of a specific year's text — for example,
  to confirm exactly what 606.170 said on the date of a past reaction investigation.
